items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: The mention of 'Father Turner' occurs entirely within the [INTERVIEWER]'s turns. The [INTERVIEWEE] does not speak in the provided context, nor does the interviewer attribute any personal relationship or direct interaction between Ferrand Clementin and Father Turner.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Well that's all my members of my family. I got kind of forgotten when I stood and made some holes around there. So they were all new men. I used to take care of the hunger boys.

I used to come to those bazaars up there. Yeah. Father Turner before him, huh? Yeah, Father Turner before him. Yeah, I used to come there all the time because Louis James was an old friend of mine. Yeah.
And Father Frank said, he wanted twenty thousand dollars. He got it. He got it.
